topics.name: #R Routine Root
topics.purpose: Define `#R` as the reserved root for inert authored Routine definitions, distinct from active Runner execution state and from `&` invocation semantics.

semantics.owner_rule: #R resolves to the canonical Routine Registry.
semantics.inert_rule: Definitions under #R are inert authored data until explicitly invoked.
semantics.invocation_rule: `&` or another explicit canonical run operation invokes a Routine.
semantics.runner_rule: Active execution state belongs to Runner/Routine runtime state, not the #R definition.
semantics.identity_rule: Routine identity is explicit and independent from source file path.
semantics.authority_rule: Reading or editing #R does not grant run authority.
semantics.ordering_rule: Routine causality/order comes from explicit Routine behavior semantics, not incidental JSON position.

invariants.rule: Each reserved runtime root resolves to one explicit semantic owner/family; the root itself never creates semantic ownership or runtime authority.

hard_gates.condition: Routine identity inferred solely from file path
Routine definition conflated with active Runner state
Routine execution order inferred only from incidental serialization order
